title: Studio Interfaces: the list-view inspector's Filter "Add filter" adds no row — no list-view filter can be authored in Studio
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The filter section is visible and the button responds, but nothing is added, so list views can only be filtered through the API.

## Reproduction

1. `/_console/studio/<pkg>/interfaces?surface=object:<obj>&nav=<nav>` → list-view inspector › Filter "+ Add filter…" → "Add filter" → no row (twice). Draft unchanged.
2. The same filter written via `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/…` works end to end (L3 pass).

## Expected

"Add filter" adds an editable condition row, held until complete.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`FilterBuilderField` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/widgets.tsx`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts` (~210) `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules` drops the blank row before it can be edited. Possibly a regression around the filter-fold work in closed #26306 / #26348.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured twice by the view gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Filtering a list view is one of the most common authoring tasks; a designer that cannot do it fails the "designer must author what the protocol declares" rule (p1).
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p1.
- Dedupe: semantic search `list view inspector Add filter adds no row, filter cannot be authored in Studio` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 2 hits (open #26703 page-designer list block has no inspector fields — different surface; closed #24640).
- QA id: U10
